2921-3682-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-3682-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Mox Amber, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

792-1829-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-1829-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

225-1662-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-1662-2645-3430.description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Karoo
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

225-2577-3967-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
225-2577-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

6982-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When that creature enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

141-3899-7446.easyPrerequisites: There's a nonland permanent card in your graveyard.
141-3899-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1115-1991-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-1991-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1636-6867-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-6867-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Appa triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

4872-6568-7722.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Y'shtola Rhul.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Warp from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2525-3358-5434.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1292-3117-5078-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1292-3117-5078-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-4676-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters.
When Elegant Edgecrafters dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Elegant Edgecrafters enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4050-5571-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
4050-5571-6922--6.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Blightbeetle and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 3.

3490-4050-6283-6720.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-6283-6720.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

509-1267-5517-5548.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Medomai the Ageless has a +1/+1 counter on it.
509-1267-5517-5548.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Sword of Truth and Justice's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris and Sword of Truth and Justice trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Truth and Justice trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, then putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 6.

277-1170-3389-5921-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3821-4222-5921-5970-6120.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Marina.
3821-4222-5921-5970-6120.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
3821-4222-5921-5970-6120.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Bottomless Pool.
Activate Freed form the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Bottomless Pool.
Bottomless Pool triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Activate Freed form the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

38-1657-2028.notablePrerequisites: Murderous Redcap does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-1657-2028.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Murderous Redcap, adding {R}.
When Murderous Redcap dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Activate Hexavus' second ability by paying {1} and removing the -1/-1 counter from Murderous Redcap, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hexavus.
Repeat.

2178-5256-5698.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Ulamog's Dreadsire does not have summoning sickness.
2178-5256-5698.description:
Activate Ulamog's Dreadsire by tapping it, creating a 10/10 Eldrazi creature tokens.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Eldrazi token.
When the Eldrazi token dies, Ulamog's Dreadsire triggers, untapping Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Eldrazi's power.
Repeat.

186-2816-3371.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Codie.
186-2816-3371.description:
Activate Codie by paying {3} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Codie by paying {2} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and sorcery card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

602-2677.notablePrerequisites: You have between eight and ten cards in your hand.
602-2677.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size and remove all damage from all permanents.
Feast of Sanity triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Flumph and causing you to gain one life.
Flumph triggers, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 as necessary for each remaining trigger.
Once all triggers have been resolved, and all players pass priority, another cleanup step will occur, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size and remove all damage from all permanents.
Repeat from step 2.

1124-2032-2034-3650-4450.notablePrerequisites: Elspeth's Talent attached to another planeswalker you control.
1124-2032-2034-3650-4450.description:
Activate the planeswalker with Elspeth's Talent attached by putting two loyalty counters on it, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Kiora by removing zero loyalty counters from it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.

864-2281-4191-5256.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness dies, Saffi triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 2, causing target player to mill cards equal to Eternal Witness's power.
Cast Saffi by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

117-185-2103-2501-3098.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} on the first turn, with at most {6}{U}{U}{U} available each other extra turn
117-185-2103-2501-3098.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater.
You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
117-185-2103-2501-3098.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U} and sacrificing a creature with power two or greater, targeting yourself.
Capture of Jingzhou's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Capture of Jingzhou trigger, copying it, targeting yourself.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Capture of Jingzhous, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your last extra turn.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing a Drake, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Call to Mind's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Call to Mind trigger, copying it, targeting Capture of Jingzhou.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Call to Minds, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U} and sacrificing a Drake, targeting Call to Mind.
Mystic Retrieval's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Retrieval trigger, copying it, targeting Capture of Jingzhou.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Repeat from step 7.

142-2210-3175-3263.notablePrerequisites: At least three loyalty counters on Saheeli Rai.
142-2210-3175-3263.description:
Activate Saheeli Rai's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, creating a token copy of Sun Titan with haste.
When the Sun Titan token enters the battlefield, return Mirrormade from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Saheeli Rai.
Put the oldest Saheeli Rai in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Mirrormade's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, creating a token copy of Sun Titan with haste.
When the Sun Titan token enters the battlefield, return Saheeli Rai from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put the oldest Saheeli Rai in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

1429-2257-2829-2890-4381.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Protean Hulk available.
1429-2257-2829-2890-4381.description:
Cause Protean Hulk to die.
Protean Hulk triggers, searching your library for Lesser Masticore, Reckles Fireweaver, and Arcbound Ravager, and then putting them onto the battlefield.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
Lesser Masticore triggers, returning itself to the battlefield.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
